note: What an arm was designed or adopted for — multi-valued, because most arms have more than one. A role is a design intent recorded from sources, never a recommendation: SPEC.md §14 forbids ranking any arm on effectiveness for any use.

terms.label: Assault rifle
terms.description: Intermediate cartridge, select fire, detachable magazine — the technical definition, stated in the glossary.

terms.label: General-purpose automatic
terms.description: The general-purpose machine gun role: sustained automatic fire from a bipod or a tripod, in a full-power rifle cartridge. Added in the Phase 8 pilot batch, where the PKM had no role term that fitted.

terms.label: Law enforcement
terms.description: Adopted for police and other civil-enforcement issue. Distinct from the duty sidearm role, which is specifically a handgun.
